decision_rule: Among the probe windows that cleared their own comparison, the largest gap in characters between any two wavelengths. At most 10 characters counts as one wavelength shared across windows. Fewer than two clearing windows leaves the gap undefined.
metric: Largest gap in characters between any two wavelengths, among the probe windows that cleared their own comparison.
notes: Fewer than two clearing windows leaves this gap undefined, and it is recorded as absent rather than as a number. A further run of this script on the same box is a rerun of the same instrument, not a replication.

values.run_void_reason: the anchor gate failed: held-out fit quality 0.859740 falls outside the measured band 0.767394 to 0.794606, so every result this run produces is an instrument fault and is not evidence about the model
